Continuous contour traversal; dim travel between disconnected contours

1,700 extracted segments · 144 presented fps

Marching-square segments are joined into contours, then traversed in nearest-endpoint order. A Gaussian beam integrates along the moving segment; a persistent energy buffer decays exponentially. Travel between contours has very low intensity.

RIVE → TEXTURE → RIVE

The final marks can be Rive too.

Compare fitted Gaussian shader splats with eight concentric translucent ellipses per mark, drawn by the official Rive renderer. Adaptive image patches put smaller marks around color changes; edge-aligned ellipses follow local gradients. Both routes use the same fitted marks and widths; very dark marks are omitted. A fixed ordinary Rive shape pool updates every display frame. It uses 24 or fewer source-derived colors and a bounded mark budget; the static snapshot export keeps full sampled color. This is per-frame 2D image fitting, not a trained 3D Gaussian scene. This illustrates an approximation with a real vector cost, not an arbitrary Gaussian feather feature in vanilla Rive.

IMAGE HISTORY AS A VOLUME

Time becomes the third axis.

Studio mode stores 128 actual 512 × 512 frames and raymarches up to 192 samples per ray. RGB, motion density and iso-sheets share that history. STM uses luminance as height; it is an image relief, not recovered scene depth. Beam traces ordered extracted contours into a decaying phosphor buffer.

RUNTIME OWNERSHIP

A working hybrid, with clear boundaries.

The imported artboard, timelines and state machines use official Rive. Oil, Gaussian splats, beam and space-time use custom WebGL2. The browser extracts image contours; the desktop beam also has original path access. Hybrid HTML is self-contained, but is not a native .rivx or GPU Canvas .riv export. GPU Canvas export status →

Sample credits and provenance · Imported files remain on your device. Timelines and state-machine boolean, number and trigger inputs are supported. Pointer listeners use artboard coordinates. External image/font dependencies are not packaged automatically. Captured histories increase export size; Studio history occupies 128 MiB uncompressed on the GPU.
